mapper.select: SELECT CASE e.gender WHEN 1 THEN '男性员工' WHEN 2 THEN '女性员工' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM emp e GROUP BY e.gender ORDER BY e.gender
SELECT IFNULL(job, 0) AS job, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp GROUP BY job ORDER BY job
SELECT IFNULL(degree, 0) AS degree, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student GROUP BY degree ORDER BY degree
SELECT c.name AS clazzName, COUNT(s.id) AS cnt FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.clazz_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
